June, in #strategic-pod: on 1 Jul at 09:17 Gideon said he closed ticket #8841 with support. The fix he described was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, which their IT did. The standard Detention Summary template then worked for their billing team. I've replied in the thread on your message.

Our other records describe #8841 differently: one has it as a Newark kiosk issue and another as an Allentown gate kiosk timeout. Check the ticket itself before you rely on those details for the QBR.
